meta.title: AI chat applies a prompt to the Line Items section

plan.title: AI chat applies prompt to Line Items

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create a technical stage, which is the subject of the test.
Apply a technical-stage template before configuring questions.
Provide multiple line items so the Line Items questionnaire section exists.
Generate and populate the technical questions, including Line Items and Vendor Assessment sections.
Open the AI chat panel required by the test setup.

args.goal: In the open AI chat panel, choose the Line Items section, type an instruction that changes its questions, click Send, and verify that the Line Items questions change while the Vendor Assessment questions remain unchanged.

steps.note: Perform and verify the chat interaction because the catalog has no dedicated step for selecting the chat section, entering its prompt, or checking the resulting question changes.
Confirm the AI interaction completed without an application error.
